subject.title: fix: keep inbound metadata in runtime context

question: Should maintainers refresh this focused runtime-context handoff PR, or make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272 the canonical landing path for the same active-turn metadata problem?
rationale: Both PRs touch agent prompt/session-state behavior; the newer PR is mergeable and covers tail placement plus provider cache anchors, but it has not merged and this PR is paired with its still-open linked issue.

options.title: Use the newer tail-carrier PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272 as canonical because it keeps the clean-prompt handoff and adds tail placement plus provider cache-anchor handling.

options.title: Refresh this focused PR
options.body: Resolve this branch against current main and land only the narrower prompt-cleanliness fix, leaving byte-stability/provider-cache placement to follow-up work.

options.title: Pause both for contract review
options.body: Keep both PRs open while maintainers decide the permanent active-turn metadata and cache-stability contract.

recommendation.title: Use the newer tail-carrier PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272 as canonical because it keeps the clean-prompt handoff and adds tail placement plus provider cache-anchor handling.
